subject: SOC 2 follow-up: control verification, MFA exports, and audit-period clarification
messages:
From: Priya Shah <ciso@healthsync.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@healthsync.com; Jordan Lee <auditor@bridge-assurance.com>
Date: Sat, 10 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 follow-up: MFA extracts and access-review evidence

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the SOC 2 Type II report you shared last week. Our audit team is reviewing the report and has requested specific control evidence beyond the report PDF to close a few control objectives. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide: 

- MFA enrollment/export showing user last-enrolled timestamp and authentication methods for the audit period (2024-04-01 to 2025-03-31)
- Results and supporting artifacts from the most recent privileged access review (who was reviewed, remediation tickets, review date)
- System access logging coverage for the infra components that process customer data (sample logs or an exported bundle and retention policy)
- A bridge letter or statement covering the gap between the SOC 2 report end date and our contract effective date (we need wording and effective dates)

Jordan (cc'd) is the external auditor; please let us know if you need a standard evidence checklist or if you prefer to route requests through procurement. We're trying to finalize the assessment by 2025-05-16.

Best,
Priya Shah
CISO, HealthSync Inc.

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <ciso@healthsync.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Jordan Lee <auditor@bridge-assurance.com>
Date: Sat, 10 May 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 follow-up: MFA extracts and access-review evidence

Hi Priya -- thanks for the clear list. We're prepared to provide the items you called out. Quick notes and next steps: 

- MFA export: we can provide a CSV export with enrollment and method metadata covering the requested audit period. It will include user id, role, last_enrolled_at, and configured method(s).
- Access reviews: security ran quarterly privileged access reviews; we can provide the review roster, reviewer signoff, and remediation ticket references for 2024 Q2–2025 Q1.
- Logging: we'll provide a compressed sample of access logs for the components in scope plus our logging retention policy (retention is 13 months for auth/access logs). Full raw logs are sensitive; we'll provide redacted/sample bundles and a statement of retention and collection coverage.
- Bridge letter: legal/security can draft a short bridge letter confirming the scope and effective dates — we'll propose wording.

Evelyn (security) is on this thread and will run the exports. Aditya from our account team will coordinate timelines and the signed evidence workflow with procurement. Expect the first bundle by Monday 2025-05-12.

Would you like evidence delivered via the Drive link or via a secure SFTP link (we can provide temporary credentials)?

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <ciso@healthsync.com>; Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Jordan Lee <auditor@bridge-assurance.com>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 follow-up: MFA extracts and access-review evidence

Hello Priya and team,

Following up with the evidence plan. Summary of what we'll attach and what remains for legal wording: 

1) MFA export (attached: mfa_enrollments_20250510.csv) — columns: user_id, email, role, last_enrolled_at (UTC), auth_methods (TOTP, WebAuthn, SMS-disabled), status. We include service accounts flagged separately.

2) Access review artifacts (attached: access_review_history_2024Q1-2025Q1.csv) — reviewer, review_date, account reviewed, outcome, remediation_ticket_id. Where remediation exists, we include the ticket link to our internal tracker (redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-####).

3) Logging sample bundle (attached as kv_access_logs_2025-04-30-export.zip) — redacted token values; includes timestamps, user_id, action, resource, region. Note: full log archives are stored in our secure bucket; we do not share full unredacted production logs externally, but can provide additional redacted slices by request. Retention policy doc is included in the SOC2 packet PDF.

4) Bridge letter: legal needs to approve formal language; I've drafted a one-page statement we can send for signature. It confirms the SOC 2 report period (2023-04-01 to 2024-03-31) and states no material control changes since the report as of 2025-05-12; that said, legal prefers we phrase it as 'management statement' and not a replacement for a SOC report. Neha / Aditya — can you confirm whether HealthSync needs a signed legal bridge letter or a management attestation is sufficient for procurement?

Attachments in this message are CSVs and a zip. If Jordan needs specific CSV columns or an expanded log timeframe, please list which fields/time window you need and we'll see if we can accommodate within data-sharing policy.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Information Security | Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwood.com

Attachments: mfa_enrollments_20250510.csv (CSV), access_review_history_2024Q1-2025Q1.csv (CSV), kv_access_logs_2025-04-30-export.zip (redacted logs)

From: Jordan Lee <auditor@bridge-assurance.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>; Priya Shah <ciso@healthsync.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>; Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 follow-up: MFA extracts and access-review evidence

Thanks Evelyn — that looks good. A couple of clarifying asks from the audit team: 

- Can you confirm the SOC 2 report period quoted in your note? Priya's request referenced 2024-04-01 to 2025-03-31; Evelyn mentioned 2023-04-01 to 2024-03-31 for the report. We just need consistent dates and a bridge letter to cover any gap.
- For the MFA export, please include an indicator for whether MFA was forced (policy) or optional at time of enrollment, if available.
- For privileged access review artifacts, a copy/snapshot of the sign-off (screenshot or exported approval record) is helpful where possible.

If those items are included in the bundle, we can mark those controls 'tested' and close them in our assessment. If you prefer, we can accept a redacted sample of sign-offs plus a commitment to provide the full approval trace under an NDA/secure portal.

Best,
Jordan Lee
Senior Auditor | Bridge Assurance

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <ciso@healthsync.com>; Jordan Lee <auditor@bridge-assurance.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, procurement@healthsync.com
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 follow-up: control verification, MFA exports, and audit-period clarification

Priya / Jordan — thanks for the quick review. Final confirmations and delivery plan: 

- SOC 2 report period: the Redwood SOC 2 Type II report covers 2023-04-01 through 2024-03-31. We've prepared a short management bridge attestation that extends statements of control to 2025-05-12; legal is ready to sign a formal bridge letter if HealthSync requires that exact legal format. (Draft bridge attestation will be uploaded to the Drive link.)

- MFA export: updated export includes 'policy_enforced' field (true/false) and is attached in this bundle (mfa_enrollments_20250510.csv).

- Access review sign-offs: attached CSV includes remediation_ticket_id; screenshots/exported approval records will be uploaded to the secure Drive folder (shared link below). If HealthSync requires the native approval trace, we can provide it under a short NDA or secure transfer.

- Logs: sample bundle attached. If you need a longer timeframe for logs, list the exact dates and fields and we'll evaluate scope and redaction needs.

Delivery: all items are uploaded to the secure Drive folder here: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/HealthSync/SOC2-2024 (DocuSign/bridge letter draft: https://docusign.net/ndoc/abc123). We will also place a copy on temporary SFTP if you prefer.

Next action: Priya / procurement — please confirm whether management attestation is acceptable or if you need our legal bridge letter signed. Once confirmed, we will finalize the DocuSign and provide requested approval traces.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments included in Drive: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2024.pdf, mfa_enrollments_20250510.csv, access_review_history_2024Q1-2025Q1.csv, kv_access_logs_2025-04-30-export.zip
